products.careInstructions:
Sheep Leather
Sheep leather varsity and fashion jackets are softer and need gentle care. Dust them with a clean, dry cloth after use. For small marks, dab with a damp cloth and a drop of mild leather cleaner. Let the jacket dry on a hanger at normal room temperature. Use a light, soft leather conditioner made for fine skins.

Do: Test any cleaner on a hidden seam first.
Do: Keep the jacket away from oils, perfume, and hair spray.
Do not: Scrub hard, bend the leather sharply, or use rough tools.
Do not: Machine wash or use bleach.

products.careInstructions:
Care Instructions
Soft-Shell Fabric
Soft-shell fabric is used on training, team, and travel jackets. It has a smooth outer face and soft inner side. Brush off dry mud before washing. Use cold water, gentle cycle, and a small amount of mild liquid detergent. Skip fabric softener so the water-repellent finish lasts longer. Hang to dry.

Do: Close all zips and tabs before washing.
Do not: Use bleach or heavy powder detergents.
Do not: Iron on high heat or dry clean with harsh solvents.

products.careInstructions:
Care Instructions
Nylon
Nylon shells are common on bomber, coach, and puffer jackets. They are light and dry fast but dislike high heat. Wash in cold water on a gentle cycle with mild detergent. Rinse well so no soap film stays on the shell. Shake out and hang to dry. Use low heat only if you must use a dryer.

Do: Spot clean small stains with mild soap before a full wash.
Do: Close all zips and snaps before washing.
Do not: Use bleach or strong stain sprays.
Do not: Iron on high heat or expose to open flame.
Quilted / Polyester Linings
Quilted polyester linings sit inside varsity, bomber, and puffer jackets. They add light padding and need gentle care. Turn the jacket inside out so the lining is on the outside. Wash in cold water, gentle cycle, and mild detergent. Avoid long, hard spins so the fill stays even. Shake the jacket after washing to spread the padding, then hang to dry.

Do: Smooth the lining by hand while it is still damp.
Do: Store the jacket fully dry to prevent odor and mildew.
Do not: Twist or wring the quilted parts.
Do not: Use high dryer heat, which can damage the fill.

products.careInstructions:
Care Instructions
Polyester Satin
Polyester satin is often used on baseball and retro varsity jackets. It has a slick face that can snag. Turn the jacket inside out and place it in a mesh bag. Wash in cold water on a gentle cycle with mild detergent. Hang or lay flat to dry so the fabric keeps its smooth look and drape.

Do: Steam from the inside if the jacket wrinkles.
Do: Store on padded hangers to avoid hanger dents.
Do not: Use a hot iron directly on the satin face.
Do not: Wash with items that have open zips or hooks.
